Sign the CLI in and out, and see who it is signed in as.

Usage:
  voidhash auth <command> [flags]

Commands:
  login      Sign in by approving a code in your browser.
  logout     Sign out on this computer.
  status     Show who the CLI is signed in as (the same as 'whoami').

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash auth <command> --help' for more about a command.
